argument: The sentence contains 'and' joining two course codes, which according to the definition of ceterms:alternativeCondition implies a context where multiple alternatives exist; however, within that specific group joined by 'and', the definition of ceterms:requires suggests every item is required. Thus, 'CSCE 31903 and CSCE 46103' forms an 'all_of' node because both must be taken together. The word 'or' separates this combined requirement from the text describing graduate standing. According to the definition of ceterms:alternativeCondition, since more than one alternative path is defined (taking both courses OR having the standing), and any one path fulfills the parent condition, the root node is an 'any_of'. The text portion is parsed as a single unit because it describes a specific class standing condition without internal logical operators separating distinct requirements.
